title: pouteria torta
intro: Pouteria torta, commonly known as Pau Marimbo or Marumuru, is a species of tree in the family Sapotaceae. It is native to the Amazon rainforest and has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its numerous health benefits. The plant is reported to have anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including wound healing, pain relief, and immune system support. The bioactive constituents of Pouteria torta include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are believed to be responsible for its medicinal properties.
